split_rule: wins sorted by match_id; index i with i%10==9 -> holdout; else fit. Losses/draws are held out of fit for rule derivation; skimmed separately for failure modes.

definitions.pass: inferred no army drop on owned cells between ticks
definitions.reaction_latency: ticks from first visible enemy tile (Chebyshev fog) to first of: first_capture event, inferred capture move, or stack step toward visible_enemy_tile / known general
definitions.castle_built_lag: event stamped at first production, ~2 ticks after spend

turn_modulo.note: Ticks 0-1 are excluded from modulo tables: every fit win passes both (general army starts at 1; leave-1 is impossible).

castle_timing.mod2_note: All castle_built stamps land on even ticks because detection keys off production (+1 on even ticks). This is a detector artifact, not evidence that the spend action is even-only.

claims.claim: Fit wins act almost every tick after the opening: global pass_rate=0.0116 (911/78749); per-game median=0.0110, p90=0.0203.
claims.threshold: pass_rate < 0.03 per game after accounting for ticks 0-1

claims.claim: Every fit win passes tick 0 and tick 1 (rates 1.00/1.00). Tick 3 is also often a pass (0.45 of games). After tick 5, passes are rare.
claims.threshold: no move on ticks 0-1; optional pass on tick 3 while army grows

claims.claim: Full (leave-1) moves dominate half-moves: global full=0.661, half=0.010. Per-game half median=0.0083.
claims.threshold: use full moves by default; half_rate < 0.05

Mid-game (51-200) is essentially zero-pass.

Reaction to first visible enemy tile is immediate: median latency=0.0 ticks, p75=1.0, p90=3.0, max=18.0 (n=341). Kinds: {'toward_visible_enemy': 160, 'inferred_capture_move': 165, 'first_capture_event': 16}. First visible enemy median tick=82.0.

claims.claim: After excluding ticks 0-1: odd pass=0.0047, even pass=0.0012. Before bulk (t%50==49) pass=0.0029 is LOWER than other odd ticks (0.0048). No wait-for-bulk-growth pattern.
claims.threshold: do NOT idle before tick%50==0; keep acting through growth boundaries

claims.claim: Median first_contact=82.0 (38.33% of game length); first_general_sight=180.0 (88.65%); game_length=202.0. Sight→kill median=24.0 ticks (p25=2.0, p75=59.0). Contact→sight median gap=93.0 ticks.
claims.threshold: contact ~tick 70-90; sight often late (~0.89 of game); convert sight to kill in ~24 ticks median
claims.note: kill_tick ≈ game_length on wins (game ends on general capture), so kill_frac≈1 is tautological; use kill_minus_sight.

claims.claim: First castle_built production stamp: median=10.0; exactly tick 10 in 168/256 castle games; ≤12 in 181. Overall castle events n=385 in 256/341 games. mod50 mass at residue 10: 184.
claims.threshold: if building a castle, first production often appears at tick 10
